## Does it belong in the framework

Reusable capability (windows, input, text, layout, components, rendering,
accessibility, lifecycle, headless control) belongs in Viva. Product behaviour
belongs in the application. Say which one this is, and why.

## Cost

<!-- Viva links only what an application uses. If this needs to be in the
release path for everyone, say what it costs. If it can be an optional package,
a build tag, or a source-owned component, say that instead. -->
